admin.description: ADMIN (user_id 999), may see and manage every appointment

doctor.description: DOCTOR carol (doctor_id 101), may see and manage every appointment

patient_bob.description: PATIENT bob (patient_id 2), a second patient for ownership checks

business_rules.description: The department catalog is public (no token needed) and lists every department with id, name, code and description.
An unknown department returns 404 with a JSON error body.
The optional department_id filter returns only the doctors of that department.
An unknown doctor returns 404; every doctor has a max_daily_quota (the clinic limit is 20 appointments per doctor per day).
The date query must be a real calendar date in YYYY-MM-DD (otherwise 422); a slot that is already booked has is_available false.
A patient sees only their own appointments.
The clinic is closed on Sundays and on the fixed holidays 2026-12-25 and 2026-01-01; booking such a day is rejected with 409.
A doctor cannot have two appointments in the same slot of the same day and accepts at most 20 appointments per day; both conflicts return 409.
An appointment can be rescheduled only at least 24 hours before it starts (otherwise 409); the sandbox clock is fixed at 2026-10-10T08:00:00Z.
Cancelling returns 204 and removes the appointment; a patient may cancel only their own appointments (another patient's -> 403) while DOCTOR and ADMIN may cancel any.
